subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should this PR's phase-aware stuck-recovery classification become the supported replay boundary for diagnostic recovery?
rationale: The patch matches the earlier maintainer direction and has no concrete code finding, but allowing active model-call stalls to use idle-timeout fallback while keeping side-effecting tools and stale recovery out of replay paths is a session-state policy choice.

options.title: Accept Phase-Aware Boundary
options.body: Land after owner review with the current model-call versus side-effecting-tool distinction as the supported diagnostic recovery behavior.

options.title: Require Broader Recovery Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers see additional runtime proof across more model-call, tool-call, stale recovery, and reply-run paths on the latest main.

options.title: Pause For Timing Work
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98580 settles if maintainers want recovery timing and recovery classification reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Accept Phase-Aware Boundary
recommendation.body: Land after owner review with the current model-call versus side-effecting-tool distinction as the supported diagnostic recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and authored the replay-safety requirement that this PR now implements.
